integrity.derivation: Conditional Gaussian Gram fourth moments and positive two-state transfer matrix; exact arithmetic identities corroborated by a standalone checker.

limitations: Independent standard Gaussian real TT cores, identical mode dimensions and common bond rank; identity-matrix single-probe trace estimate only.
Variance statements are not tail probability guarantees and do not extend without proof to arbitrary matrices or orthogonalized or normalized TT cores.
Mathematical priority may be affected by earlier equivalent tensor-network norm moment calculations.
title: Exact identity-trace variance and square-root rank transition for Gaussian tensor trains
